output.sql:
SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
output.explanation: Revenue is net_revenue from completed orders (is_revenue = true), restricted to orders dated in 2025 (fiscal year equals calendar year). Orders are joined to dim_customers for the company name, grouped per customer, summed, rounded to 2 decimals, and the top five are returned in descending order. Shipping fees are excluded because net_revenue does not include them.
